about: COPY DOWN onto a floor whose cells were removed: its empty slots stay, so it was refused with 'the floor below is not empty'. An empty floor with the same slots now gets the cells; empty slots in another layout get a message saying so; a floor with a cell is still refused. Fresh game; add_floor makes the floors.

steps.why: source floor: a WALL 1 left of the entrance
and an empty small slot on the right
the floor below: the same slots, no cells (cells removed)

steps.name: gnx_floor_copy_down
steps.why: an empty floor with the same slots: copied (it said 'not empty')
the next floor: an empty big slot, another layout

steps.name: gnx_scn_copy_down_msg
steps.why: empty slots in another layout: a message that says so

steps.name: gnx_scn_copy_down_msg
steps.why: a floor below with a cell is still refused
